## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D dungeon-crawl game inspired by World of Warcraft and Dungeons & Dragons 3.5.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Finish with a brief note of assumptions.
- Check gameplay with a screenshot saved as a small JPEG, viewport at most 1280px wide; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original fantasy setting, “Embervault — The Sunken Reliquary,” with D20-inspired combat and a solo fighter protagonist.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a responsive game interface, dungeon scenery, hero and guardian models, combat HUD, quest panel, inventory modal, and touch controls.

### Active
- Finish `game.js`: the file currently ends after spawning three goblins; gameplay event handlers, combat, boss encounter, update/render loop, and resize handling are not present in the current version.
- Run the game, debug it, and verify a screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing `game.js` from its current truncated state; provide movement, target selection, D20 attacks, abilities, enemy AI, progression, boss, victory/defeat, and render loop.
2. Check for JavaScript errors and confirm the game starts and is playable.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues.
4. Summarize the assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and Three.js import map.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and partial world/entities; currently incomplete.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `game.js` was rewritten most recently and currently includes scene construction, hero creation, three goblins, and state declarations, but no game loop or interactions.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D dungeon-crawl game inspired by World of Warcraft and Dungeons & Dragons 3.5.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Verify gameplay with a screenshot saved as a small JPEG, viewport at most 1280px wide; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use an original fantasy setting, “Embervault — The Sunken Reliquary,” with D20-inspired combat and a solo fighter protagonist.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the game HUD, quest and inventory interfaces, start/death screens, and controls.
- Created `style.css` with responsive desktop/mobile styling and touch controls.
- Added partial Three.js dungeon scenery, hero and goblin models, and initial game state in `game.js`.

### Active
- Finish `game.js`: it currently ends after spawning three goblins; combat handlers, boss encounter, progression, enemy AI, update/render loop, and resize handling are missing.
- Run the game, debug it, and verify that it starts and is playable.
- Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing `game.js` from the current partial state, including movement, targeting, D20 attacks, abilities, enemy AI, progression, boss, victory/defeat, and render loop.
2. Run the game and check for JavaScript errors and basic playability.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Partial Three.js scene and entity setup; gameplay is not implemented yet.
- `index.html`: Game UI and Three.js import map.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch controls.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- No gameplay run, debugging, or screenshot verification has been completed.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf
